say: Your display is marketing. Use a clean, readable sign, put best sellers in front, and show prices.

say: Yetunde in Abeokuta gives a free 1 kg of beans, costing her about 1,500 naira, to any customer who brings a new one. A new regular brings about 1,200 naira gross profit a week, so the reward pays for itself in about two weeks.

say: On WhatsApp Business, post clear daylight photos with the price, new restocks, and useful tips. Nneka in Onitsha posts three status updates each morning.

say: Then ask every new customer how they heard about you, and tally the answers. Repeat what works. And be careful with discounts, which come straight out of gross profit.

say: Never release goods because of a screenshot, a forwarded SMS or a transfer receipt. Check your own bank or payment app. Fake alerts are common tricks.

Never share your bank PIN, OTP, BVN details or WhatsApp code, even with someone who says they are from your bank. Turn on two-step verification. And add people to broadcast lists only with their permission.

say: Hauwa in Minna is offered a 200,000 naira loan from a microfinance bank to buy stock in bulk. Interest is 5 percent flat per month for 6 months.

panel.heading: Can Hauwa afford this loan?
items: Loan ₦200,000 at 5% flat per month, 6 months
Interest ₦60,000; processing fee ₦4,000
Total cost of borrowing: ₦64,000
Extra profit expected: about ₦12,000 a month
Gain after cost: only about ₦1,300 a month

say: 5 percent of 200,000 is 10,000 naira a month, so 60,000 naira of interest. A processing fee of 2 percent, 4,000 naira, is taken at the start.

say: That leaves only about 1,300 naira a month, and a slow month would turn it into a loss. So she saves through her cooperative for three months, then borrows a smaller amount from it at lower cost.
Always get the total repayment in writing, and check it fits your monthly profit.

say: Watch for three warning signs. First, real grants never ask you to pay processing or registration fees to receive money.

cards.d: Real grants never ask you to pay a fee to receive the money.
Be wary of lenders who want your phone contacts. Check FCCPC's approved list.
Never share them. Check a lender is licensed by the Central Bank of Nigeria.

say: Second, be wary of loan apps that want your phone contacts. Some abuse borrowers' contacts. Check the FCCPC list of approved digital lenders.

cards.d: Real grants never ask you to pay a fee to receive the money.
Be wary of lenders who want your phone contacts. Check FCCPC's approved list.
Never share them. Check a lender is licensed by the Central Bank of Nigeria.

say: Third, nobody genuine needs your BVN, PIN or OTP. Check that any lender is licensed by the Central Bank of Nigeria.

say: Here is a worked example. Comfort sells provisions in Calabar and makes about 80,000 naira net profit a month. She splits it into three parts and writes the split down.

card.title: Comfort splits her monthly profit
card.note: Naira figures are illustrative and approximate.

say: 40,000 naira personal pay, 15,000 for her reserve, and 25,000 as growth money.

card.title: Comfort splits her monthly profit
card.note: Naira figures are illustrative and approximate.

say: Over three months, her growth money buys 75,000 naira of extra stock in her three fastest items, so she stops running out.
Customers ask for frozen chicken, so she buys only what is pre-ordered on WhatsApp. Once demand is proven, she buys a second-hand freezer, without a loan.

say: You are ready to grow when you have made a net profit for three to six months in a row, your best sellers often run out, and you have a reserve and up-to-date records.

panel.heading: Signs and safeguards
left: A cash reserve and good records

say: As you grow, protect the business. Keep at least two suppliers for your main items, do not let one big buyer become most of your sales, and control credit, because it can drain your cash fast.

panel.heading: Signs and safeguards
left: A cash reserve and good records

say: To remember. Grow word of mouth with a neat display and referrals. Confirm every payment in your own app. Ask for the total repayment in writing. Never pay to receive a grant. And split your profit into pay, reserve and growth money.

items: Word of mouth, referrals and a neat display
